description: This file contains the implementation of the VisitService interface for managing Visit entities in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, ending, voiding, and purging visits, as well as handling visit types and attributes.

classes.name: VisitServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the VisitService that manages Visit entities within OpenMRS, including functionalities for managing visit types, attributes, and the lifecycle of visits.

methods.name: setVisitDAO
methods.description: Injects the data access object for visits.

methods.name: getVisitDAO
methods.description: Returns the current visit data access object.

methods.name: getAllVisitTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all visit types, optionally including retired types.

methods.name: getVisitType
methods.description: Fetches a specific visit type by ID.

methods.name: getVisitTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a visit type by its UUID.

methods.name: getVisitTypes
methods.description: Searches for visit types matching a fuzzy phrase.

methods.name: saveVisitType
methods.description: Validates and persists a visit type.

methods.name: retireVisitType
methods.description: Retires a visit type with a reason (though here it just saves).

methods.name: unretireVisitType
methods.description: Unretires a visit type.

methods.name: purgeVisitType
methods.description: Permanently deletes a visit type.

methods.name: getAllVisits
methods.description: Retrieves all visits.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Fetches a visit by its ID.

methods.name: getVisitByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a visit by its UUID.

methods.name: saveVisit
methods.description: Saves or updates a visit, handling privileges and attributes.

methods.name: endVisit
methods.description: Ends a visit by setting its stop datetime.

methods.name: voidVisit
methods.description: Voids a visit.

methods.name: unvoidVisit
methods.description: Unvoids a visit.

methods.name: purgeVisit
methods.description: Deletes a visit after ensuring it is not in use.

methods.name: getVisits
methods.description: Retrieves visits matching various collections, date ranges, and attribute filters.

methods.name: getVisits
methods.description: Retrieves visits based on search criteria.

methods.name: getVisitsByPatient
methods.description: Retrieves all visits for a specific patient.

methods.name: getActiveVisitsByPatient
methods.description: Gets all active (non-ended) visits for a patient.

methods.name: getVisitsByPatient
methods.description: Retrieves visits for a patient with options to include inactive or voided visits.

methods.name: getAllVisitAttributeTypes
methods.description: Fetches all visit attribute types.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a visit attribute type by ID.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a visit attribute type by UUID.

methods.name: saveVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Persists a visit attribute type.

methods.name: retireVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Retires a visit attribute type.

methods.name: unretireVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Unretires a visit attribute type.

methods.name: purgeVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a visit attribute type.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a visit attribute by UUID.

methods.name: stopVisits
methods.description: Automatically stops visits based on configured visit types up to a maximum start date.
